answer: Trying costs 300 stamped dockets, each costing £7 to have checked a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. To join, a name must pass Woolbound dye retailer cloth charter, which works because a charter dye retailers file after dye shop audits. The haven is on the docket. Every onyx is counted once. The harbor is checked, not assumed.
